Title: Outcome
Use when: You have a topic and a time.
Prompt: Write the outcome as something the learner can do at the end. If my topic is vague, ask what they must be able to do. Do not invent an accreditation.

Title: Timed plan
Prompt: Split the hour into explanation, a worked example using my material, and practice. Include the minutes.

Title: Exercise
Prompt: Write one exercise they can finish in the room with the materials I listed. Do not require a tool I did not mention.

Title: Check
Use when: You need to know it landed.
Prompt: Write three questions that test the outcome, not attendance.
Check: A person who missed the point would fail them.

Title: Handout
Prompt: Turn the plan into a one-page handout. No stock advice that was not in the plan.

Title: What to drop
Prompt: Tell me what to cut first if the group is slow. Do not cut the practice before the extra explanation.
